note: In-source base numerical-capability library. Each record conforms to docs/physics_research_gates/NUMERICAL_CAPABILITY_REQUIREMENT_SPEC (18 gate-callable fields). Merged read-only under the external distilled library's families F/G. Consumed by the Numerical gate at the execute stage.

capabilities.applicability_question: Any task that runs numerics whose results feed a claim.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: No numerics are run (pure theory or pure literature synthesis).
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Reproducible run configuration' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.recommended_artifacts: A config file + a manifest linking commands, params, hashes and outputs.
capabilities.basic_standard: Parameters, script, environment, seed/determinism and output paths are recorded.
capabilities.advanced_standard: A one-command replay reproduces every figure from raw data.
capabilities.publishable_standard: Independent environment rebuild + hash/manifest reproduces the results.
repair_actions: Perform 'Reproducible run configuration' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A numerical claim is downgraded to 'not reproducible' if configuration is absent.
capabilities.comparison_to_prior_work_requirement: State whether prior work released enough to reproduce and how this compares.
capabilities.example_good_use: Ships scripts/config + seeds + a manifest that regenerates each figure.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Reports numbers with no script, seed, or parameter record.
capabilities.applicability: Any task that runs numerics whose results feed a claim.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Parameters, script, environment, seed/determinism and output paths are recorded.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: A one-command replay reproduces every figure from raw data.
capabilities.pass_threshold: Independent environment rebuild + hash/manifest reproduces the results.

capabilities.applicability_question: Specific parameter points are chosen and results depend on them.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: There is a single fixed physical parameter set with no choice to justify.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Parameter-choice justification' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: A short justification per parameter point in the study plan.
capabilities.recommended_artifacts: A scan/design table linking each point to a criterion.
capabilities.basic_standard: Every parameter point states why it was chosen.
capabilities.advanced_standard: Points come from a theory criterion, prior work, or a systematic scan (not cherry-picked).
capabilities.publishable_standard: The parameter design is defensible against a reviewer probing cherry-picking.
repair_actions: Perform 'Parameter-choice justification' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A trend/claim is downgraded to 'single-point diagnostic' if points are unjustified.
capabilities.comparison_to_prior_work_requirement: State how prior work chose comparable parameters.
capabilities.example_good_use: Chooses points at the theory-predicted transition and a systematic sweep around it.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Shows one hand-picked point that happens to look good.
capabilities.applicability: Specific parameter points are chosen and results depend on them.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Every parameter point states why it was chosen.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: Points come from a theory criterion, prior work, or a systematic scan (not cherry-picked).
capabilities.pass_threshold: The parameter design is defensible against a reviewer probing cherry-picking.

capabilities.applicability_question: There is a known limit, trivial case, or analytic result to check against.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: No known reference case exists for the computed quantity.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Control / sanity check' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: A note showing the code reproduces a known result.
capabilities.recommended_artifacts: A control figure/table with quantitative agreement.
capabilities.basic_standard: A sanity check against a known limit / trivial case is reported.
capabilities.advanced_standard: The control quantitatively validates the algorithm.
capabilities.publishable_standard: Multiple independent controls bound the algorithm error.
repair_actions: Perform 'Control / sanity check' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A correctness claim is downgraded to 'unchecked' without a control.
capabilities.comparison_to_prior_work_requirement: State whether prior work used the same control.
capabilities.example_good_use: Recovers the analytic Hermitian spectrum before adding non-reciprocity.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Never checks the code against any known case.
capabilities.applicability: There is a known limit, trivial case, or analytic result to check against.
capabilities.basic_criteria: A sanity check against a known limit / trivial case is reported.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: The control quantitatively validates the algorithm.
capabilities.pass_threshold: Multiple independent controls bound the algorithm error.

capabilities.applicability_question: Results depend on a grid, step, cutoff, or bond dimension.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: The computation is exact with no discretisation parameter.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Discretisation / grid convergence' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: A statement of the resolution used.
capabilities.publishable_standard: A convergence study bounds the discretisation error below the effect size.
repair_actions: Perform 'Discretisation / grid convergence' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A quantitative claim is downgraded to 'resolution-limited' without convergence.
capabilities.example_good_use: Shows the spectrum is unchanged from L to 2L within tolerance.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Uses one grid and never checks convergence.
capabilities.applicability: Results depend on a grid, step, cutoff, or bond dimension.
capabilities.pass_threshold: A convergence study bounds the discretisation error below the effect size.

capabilities.applicability_question: The claim concerns thermodynamic-limit behaviour, phases, or scaling.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: The claim is explicitly about a fixed finite system.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Finite-size / scaling check' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: Results at more than one size.
capabilities.basic_standard: The system size choice is stated.
capabilities.advanced_standard: The trend is consistent across several sizes; extrapolation where relevant.
capabilities.publishable_standard: A finite-size scaling analysis supports the thermodynamic-limit claim.
repair_actions: Perform 'Finite-size / scaling check' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A phase/universal claim is downgraded to 'finite-size diagnostic' without scaling.
capabilities.example_good_use: Shows the gap closes with a clean 1/L trend across sizes.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Claims a phase transition from one system size.
capabilities.applicability: The claim concerns thermodynamic-limit behaviour, phases, or scaling.
capabilities.basic_criteria: The system size choice is stated.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: The trend is consistent across several sizes; extrapolation where relevant.
capabilities.pass_threshold: A finite-size scaling analysis supports the thermodynamic-limit claim.

capabilities.applicability_question: A diagnostic uses a numerical threshold to classify or count.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: No threshold is used in the analysis.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Threshold sensitivity' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: A statement of the thresholds used.
capabilities.advanced_standard: The conclusion is stable under threshold changes, or instability is explained.
capabilities.publishable_standard: A sensitivity sweep shows the conclusion is threshold-robust.
repair_actions: Perform 'Threshold sensitivity' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A count/classification claim is downgraded if it flips with the threshold.
capabilities.example_good_use: Shows the zero-mode count is stable for thresholds over a decade.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Uses one magic threshold with no sensitivity check.
capabilities.applicability: A diagnostic uses a numerical threshold to classify or count.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: The conclusion is stable under threshold changes, or instability is explained.
capabilities.pass_threshold: A sensitivity sweep shows the conclusion is threshold-robust.

capabilities.applicability_question: A claim of robustness, protection, or stability is made.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Robustness / perturbation stability' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: A perturbation check around the reported point.
capabilities.recommended_artifacts: A robustness map over perturbation strength/disorder.
capabilities.basic_standard: Whether robustness needs checking is stated.
capabilities.advanced_standard: The conclusion survives small perturbations / disorder, or the boundary is explained.
capabilities.publishable_standard: A robustness study maps where the conclusion holds and breaks.
repair_actions: Perform 'Robustness / perturbation stability' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A 'robust/protected' claim is downgraded to 'shown at one point' without a robustness check.
capabilities.comparison_to_prior_work_requirement: State how prior work established robustness.
capabilities.example_good_use: Adds disorder and shows the edge modes persist up to a stated strength.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Calls a result 'robust' from a single clean run.
capabilities.applicability: A claim of robustness, protection, or stability is made.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Whether robustness needs checking is stated.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: The conclusion survives small perturbations / disorder, or the boundary is explained.
capabilities.pass_threshold: A robustness study maps where the conclusion holds and breaks.

capabilities.applicability_question: Results carry numerical error, residual, or noise that could rival the effect.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: The computed quantity is exact to machine precision and error is irrelevant.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Error / residual / noise-floor' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.basic_standard: Residual or error magnitude is reported.
capabilities.advanced_standard: Error is compared to the main effect size.
capabilities.publishable_standard: The effect is shown to exceed the noise floor with quantified confidence.
repair_actions: Perform 'Error / residual / noise-floor' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: An effect claim is downgraded to 'within noise' if error rivals it.
capabilities.example_good_use: Shows the signal is 10x the residual with a stated tolerance.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Reports an effect the size of the solver residual with no error estimate.
capabilities.applicability: Results carry numerical error, residual, or noise that could rival the effect.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Residual or error magnitude is reported.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: Error is compared to the main effect size.
capabilities.pass_threshold: The effect is shown to exceed the noise floor with quantified confidence.

capabilities.applicability_question: Figures are produced from data and scripts.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Figure / data traceability' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.basic_standard: Every figure has a generating script.
capabilities.advanced_standard: A figure manifest links inputs, commands, params and outputs.
capabilities.publishable_standard: Every figure is regenerable from raw data by one command.
repair_actions: Perform 'Figure / data traceability' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A figure-based claim is downgraded to 'untraceable' if the figure cannot be tied to data.
capabilities.example_good_use: Ships build_figures.py + a manifest mapping each figure to its data.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Includes figures with no script or data provenance.
capabilities.applicability: Figures are produced from data and scripts.
capabilities.basic_criteria: Every figure has a generating script.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: A figure manifest links inputs, commands, params and outputs.
capabilities.pass_threshold: Every figure is regenerable from raw data by one command.

capabilities.applicability_question: A phase diagram, phase boundary, or general trend is claimed.
capabilities.non_applicability_condition: No phase-diagram or general-trend claim is made.
capabilities.usage_question: Did Argus actually perform 'Parameter scan / phase-diagram evidence' (not just plan it)?
capabilities.evidence_question: Which evidence_file shows 'Parameter scan / phase-diagram evidence' (data/figure/notebook)?
capabilities.minimum_artifact: A scan over the relevant parameter axis.
capabilities.recommended_artifacts: A phase-diagram figure with a boundary criterion.
capabilities.advanced_standard: A 2D+ scan supports the claimed boundary/trend.
capabilities.publishable_standard: A resolved phase diagram with boundary criteria and finite-size support.
repair_actions: Perform 'Parameter scan / phase-diagram evidence' and record evidence_file/evidence_location, or record if_not_used_why.
If a claim depends on it and it was not done, downgrade the claim.
capabilities.claim_downgrade_if_missing: A 'phase diagram / universal' claim is downgraded to 'single-point' without a scan.
capabilities.example_good_use: Scans two axes and marks the transition by gap closing.
capabilities.example_bad_use: Draws a phase boundary from a couple of points.
capabilities.applicability: A phase diagram, phase boundary, or general trend is claimed.
capabilities.advanced_criteria: A 2D+ scan supports the claimed boundary/trend.
capabilities.pass_threshold: A resolved phase diagram with boundary criteria and finite-size support.
